svg.aria-label: Ruộng Commit: a hillside of 12 rice terraces in Mù Cang Chải, one per month from December 2025 to November 2026, ripening from green to gold with MarkPhamm's GitHub contributions. A thatched stilt house sits on the hilltop, four koi swim in the paddy below, no farmers are out planting yet, and the sky shows dusk in Hanoi.
